title: Accounts
desc: Income, expenses, vendor payables & project P&L.
note: MODULE MANIFEST — the presence of THIS file is what auto-discovery HEAD-probes (platform/discovery/discovery.js). A module registered built:true in the company manifest but missing this file is treated as deleted.
ownership: This module owns NO table. `acc_entries` is listed under stores because this desk WRITES to it, but the table belongs to Master Accounts and is shared group-wide — Woodart is one company-scoped tenant of it, exactly as Travels is. There is deliberately no migration in backend/. Postings go through the kernel services in platform/backend/app/Services, so the group's books cannot differ by which company's screen recorded the money. See backend/endpoints.md, invariant 1.
